profile.name: RIGOL DS4043数字示波器
profile.description: 一款通过 VISA/SCPI 控制的台式数字示波器，用于采集和读取一个或多个通道的波形数据。该驱动显示其支持触发、时基、平均采样和原始波形读取，适合实验中的电信号时域观测与波形记录。
profile.description_en: A bench digital oscilloscope controlled via VISA/SCPI for acquiring and reading waveform data from one or more channels. The driver evidence shows support for trigger setup, timebase configuration, averaging, and raw waveform readout, making it suitable for time-domain electrical signal observation and waveform capture in laboratory experiments.
